author: Steve Seaback
text: Hector Sr. And Jr. Along with their grandson and son were very prompt and treated us really well. It was a real family affair and I would recommend them to anyone, friend or stranger....can't beat Hectors septic service.

author: Brandi Turnbo
text: Amazing services! Fair prices, honest, trustworthy, and dependable. Highly recommend! Hector even gave us great tips to prevent any future problems.

author: john hoots
text: I called him on Saturday morning. Our tank was full could run any water in the house. He was here in the hour. Did a great job had it pumped out in no time. Was very helpful and shared a lot on information. Thank you for the great service. I would recommend them to everyone.

author: Levi Hatano Filardo
text:
Their communication is too notch. They make sure clients are updated. Upon arrival, they made sure clients are educated in how things work. After the service, they also suggested different up keeping for the septic system.

Overall HIGHLY RECOMMEND!

author: Gerardo Rosalez
text: Never been disappointed with Hector’s Septic Service.  Very knowledgeable with septic systems and always very professional and respectful.
